extraction.design_notes: five‐centre, open‐label, parallel‐group, active comparator, phase IV randomised controlled trial with a 24‐week active treatment period

key_inclusion_criteria: age 18–80 years, HbA1c ≤9% [75 mmol/mol], total daily dose of insulin ≤0.8 IU/kg, and fasting C‐peptide above the lower limit of normal
treated with an MDI regimen (≥3 insulin injections/day) and with metformin (unless not tolerated) ± SGT2i on stable doses ≥3 months prior to screening

evidence.quote: Ninety individuals (n = 45 in both treatment groups), 71/91 (79.0%) male with mean (SD) age 66.2 (8.7) years

Ninety‐one individuals were randomly assigned for either continuation with the MDI regimen (n = 46) or initiation of iGlarLixi (n = 45). A total of 90 participants were included in the full analysis set (n = 45 for both treatment groups)

outcomes.name: mean change in HbA1c from baseline

evidence.quote: The mean (95% CI) difference in the HbA1c change between iGlarLixi and the MDI group was −0.12 (−0.48, 0.23)% (−1.39 [−5.21, 2.43] mmol/mol), indicating comparable glycaemic control in both treatment groups
No severe hypoglycaemia was reported in any of the study participants during the duration of the trial.

Covid‐19 infection was confirmed in five participants (two were in the iGlarLixi and three in the MDI groups)
